Beauty
items.body: We believe the right solution is beautiful. Not over-decorated, yet restful to the eye. The best interface is one that becomes quiet simply by being looked at.

items.title: Daily fit
items.body: We design to blend in, not to stand out. It follows the rhythm of your day, appears only when needed, and stays quiet otherwise. That is our standard.

items.title: Unity
items.body: From icons to letter spacing and the measurement of margins, everything belongs to one system. Consistency, we believe, is what earns a user's trust.

items.title: Intuition
items.body: No manual is required. Features belong where the hand naturally goes. An operation you feel you somehow already know — that is what we define as true intuition.

items.title: Lightness
items.body: We keep trimming until it opens in one second. Not making people wait is respect for their time. Building it lighter is, in the end, the most sincere thing we can do.

about.lede: What Wyatt Rainier values, why we started, and why Mount Rainier is our emblem — this page traces where we began.

vision.title: Vision
vision.p1: Solving a problem is not about standing out. It is coming home without getting lost, the train leaving on time, the document opening first thing in the morning — the day simply turning, unseen by anyone. Like VisionAir opening in 0.9 seconds, a solution always works quietly.
vision.p2: We pour that quietness straight into our products. No flash is needed. What is needed is a reassuring feel that never gets in the way, every single day. That is our vision.

philosophy.quoteA: Since our founding in 2019, we at Wyatt have continued development without ever forgetting beauty, daily fit, unity, intuition, and lightness.
philosophy.quoteB: Above all, the most important thing is that our products are ones customers can use with pride, seamlessly woven into their everyday lives.
philosophy.source: — From the Wyatt Rainier development principles

story.description: Since 2019 our scale has grown, but the standard of our judgment has not. What has changed with each passing year is only that we have gotten better at keeping it.
story.imageAlt: Team members reviewing materials in front of a whiteboard

timeline.title: Founded
timeline.body: Three former colleagues and one desk. For the first months we spent our time deciding what standard to hold, before deciding what to build.

timeline.title: Distilled into five principles
timeline.body: Beauty, daily fit, unity, intuition, lightness. Every review since has been judged on these five items alone.

timeline.title: Name and emblem finalized
timeline.body: We adopted Mount Rainier as our emblem and named the company Wyatt Rainier. 'It blends in, yet it is settled' — that tension is our ideal.

timeline.title: Internal test of VisionAir
timeline.body: We tested the slide-app prototype for six months with 12 local SMEs. Four out of five comments we received concerned lightness.

timeline.title: VisionAir launched
timeline.body: Launched completely free of charge. In the first three months it was downloaded 25,000 times.

timeline.title: 2 million cumulative downloads
timeline.body: To this day, the single metric we develop against is: a product customers use with pride, woven into daily life.

rainier.imageAlt: The main ridge of Mount Rainier, snow slopes stacked in afternoon light
rainier.quote: The emblem of Wyatt Rainier is Mount Rainier. Chosen for a presence that blends into daily life, yet remains bold at all times.
rainier.p1: When the weather is fair, Rainier is visible from everywhere; when it is not, it vanishes entirely. When it is seen, it commands the valley; when unseen, it works without a word. We saw that in the products we face every day.
rainier.p2: The name Rainier comes from the indigenous tribe that lived in this region. We wanted to carry that same respect for the land in our own name. The blue we use in our work, too, takes its color from this mountain's glaciers.
facts: Stratovolcano with some of North America's largest glaciers

products.title: VisionAir
products.subtitle: (Slide Application)
products.lede: Opens in 0.9 seconds. A slide application light as a memo, with the weight of a real document. Completely free for personal and business use.

overview.titleA: Opens as light as a memo,
overview.titleB: closes with the weight of a real document.
overview.p1: Many slide programs have grown so feature-heavy that there is no time left for the essential question: what are we trying to say. VisionAir is the opposite. Only the necessary parts, at the necessary precision — and yet it holds up, in print or on a screen, to anyone's eye.
overview.p2: We back it with numbers. 0.9 seconds to start, 86MB on first download, under 180MB of resident memory. Lightness is managed here as a figure that belongs in a specification sheet.
overview.imageAlt: VisionAir — a slide being aligned by auto-layout

features.titleB: Cut any of them out, and it is the same design philosophy.

feature1.title: Light as a memo
feature1.description: It starts in 0.9 seconds. On a five-year-old laptop, page turns still do not drop a frame — we built our own rendering engine to make sure. Waiting for something to open is not a feature.

feature2.title: Layout that aligns itself
feature2.description: Amount of text, size of figures, the spacing between margins. VisionAir arranges what you drop in like a blueprint. Time spent thinking about layout becomes time spent thinking about content.
points: Automatic adjustment of letter, line, and margin spacing
Optimized for mixed Japanese and Latin text

feature3.title: Shared with a single link
feature3.description: A finished deck opens for anyone with one URL. Allow downloads, or keep it view-only. There are exactly two permission choices, so there is nothing to hesitate over.
points: Keep editing offline; syncs automatically when back online

extra.title: Presentation mode
extra.description: Contrast is corrected for the projection environment; notes are visible to the presenter only.

extra.title: Offline support
extra.description: Every editing feature works in rooms with no signal. It syncs automatically once you are back.

extra.title: PDF / PPTX export
extra.description: Handing work to another system means compatibility always matters. Export to the major formats.

cases.title: Business

cases.title: Education / training

cases.title: Personal

cases.description: From a hobby presentation to a child's growth record — for anyone who would like making documents to be a little easier.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: If your question is not covered here, please ask via the form above.

items.a: Yes. VisionAir is completely free for personal and business use. To get the app, choose 'Download / usage' in the form and include your OS and device name — that makes it faster for us to help.

items.q: Can it open existing PowerPoint files?
items.a: Yes. It reads .pptx files, carrying over text, images, and tables as-is. Complexly placed shapes may be rearranged to fit VisionAir's auto-layout.
By default, only on your own device. If you enable Wyatt Cloud, it is stored encrypted in a data center inside Japan.

items.q: Do you offer training and support for companies?
items.a: We provide onboarding training (online or on-site) and a dedicated support desk. Please start with 'Business / corporate use' in the form.
